text:
Cole Caufield scored 51 goals last season and won the Lady Byng, and he's on pace to do it again: 11 goals in 18 games, on a four-game point streak, with Montreal's lineup in and out of the infirmary around him.

Is it real? Mostly. His 19% shooting is right at last season's 20%, which for him is talent, not luck, and he's had 7.8 expected goals. The part that will fade is the team's: the Canadiens have scored 4.6 more goals than expected with him on. By our win probability, his goals have added more wins than all but ten skaters.

Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him in the 97th percentile for chances from the slot, and Evolving-Hockey had him 12th of 401 forwards in wins above replacement, better than his goals said. One thing to watch: his ice time is down more than two minutes a night lately. Our range: 35 to 53 goals.
